title: Kretzoiarctos
description: Turns pandas into the prehistoric Kretzoiarctos!
body:
This mod retextures pandas into _Kretzoiarctos beatrix_, an extinct animal that resembles a panda with its black and white areas swapped. Fell free to make your own spins, with credit to MuddyDev!

Made with love by MuddyDev <3
Toss a coin to your lion: [https://ko-fi.com/torodev](https://ko-fi.com/torodev)
